-- TTEX Talk Scene File: DO NOT EDIT BY HAND
-- Quest #119 / Scene #3 - Function Phindous_YuriandRazed_Boss
function Phindous_YuriandRazed_Boss()
	SetTransitionType(2)
	SetFinalMusic("")
	HideOriginalObjs(1)
	Phase1()

	LoadMap("mushroom12D.fld")
	MoveCamera(784.00, 740.00, 76.34)
	RotCamera(6.24, 1.20, 20.00)

	CreateObject(0, 1086, 367.00, 465.00, 50, 1, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(1, 1086, 377.00, 485.00, 2, 1, FALSE, 0, 0)
	CreateObject(2, 1086, 387.00, 465.00, 206, 1, FALSE, 0, 0)

	Phase2()
	Phase3()
	Phase4()

	PlayMusic("BGM024.ogg")
	PlayCamera("Phin_YuriandRazed_Boss_01.cam", 0, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00)
	wait(500)
	WalkObject(0, 373.000000, 465.000000, 20.000000, 1, 4, 3)
	WalkObject(2, 381.000000, 465.000000, 240.000000, 1, 4, 3)
	WaitForObjectsStop()
	PlaySound("Sound/Monster/Stoncken/Stoncken_SKILL01.wav")
	AniObject(0, 101, 1)
	wait(300)
	AniObject(2, 8, 1)
	wait(300)
	PlaySound("Sound/Monster/Stoncken/Stoncken_SKILL03.wav")
	AniObject(2, 103, 1)
	wait(300)
	AniObject(0, 8, 1)
	wait(1900)
	WalkObject(1, 377.000000, 455.000000, 0.000000, 1, 4, 1)
	wait(200)
	PlaySound("Sound/Monster/Stoncken/Stoncken_DEAD.wav")
	WalkObject(0, 362.000000, 465.000000, 20.000000, 0, 11, 1)
	WalkObject(2, 392.000000, 465.000000, 240.000000, 0, 11, 1)
	RotateObject(0, 50, 1)
	RotateObject(2, 216, 1)
	AniObject(2, 11, 1)
	AniObject(0, 11, 1)
	wait(700)
	OpenTalkScene(12, 11)

	RevPhase4()
	RevPhase3()
	RevPhase2()

	Q.DeleteAllObject()
	RestoreMap()

	RevPhase1()
end

Register(Phindous_YuriandRazed_Boss)
